description:
The official repository for the YARC launcher (a.k.a., YAL or Yet Another Launcher).


📥 YARC Launcher downloads
- Windows 64-bit Installer
- Linux x86_64 Bundle
- MacOS Universal Bundle
Important
If you are on Linux or Steam Deck, some additional setup may be needed. Check the README for more details.
⛔ Antivirus Warnings
You may get some antivirus warnings that the YARC Launcher is a virus/trojan. This is a false-positive, and is not correct. Click here for more information.
📁 Portable YARG downloads
Portable YARG downloads are NOT RECOMMENDED! Using the launcher gets you access to YARG's official setlist and DLC, along with automatic updates. If however, you still want the portable versions, you can download them here.
📋 Changes
- Launch YARG correctly on MacOS, resolving input issues
- Show changelog instead of news on Nightly profile page
- Allow for downloading different variants of setlist and venue profiles
- Better handling of download location becoming unavailable/unwritable
- Prevent zombie processes on Linux
- Fix update icon border remaining visible after update completion on Linux and MacOS
Full Changelog: v1.2.0...v1.3.0
